description: Segment a brain MRI of any contrast or resolution into the SynthSeg 2.0 FreeSurfer labels with FreeSurfer's mri_synthseg (TensorFlow on CPU) from a local FreeSurfer install (tested with dev 2024-03-27). The label map keeps the input geometry (--keepgeom), so it lines up with masks made on the input grid; SynthSeg's own volume table comes with it.

mode.description: default: SynthSeg 2.0; fast: skip some processing; robust: slower, for clinical or low-quality scans.

labels.description: SynthSeg label map (FreeSurfer label ids) on the input grid.

volumes.description: SynthSeg's per-structure volume table (mm3), as written by --vol.

requirements: FreeSurfer 7.4 or a newer dev build (tested with dev 2024-03-27) (mri_synthseg); FREESURFER_HOME is set from the executable found
neuroflow/launch.description: Runs mri_synthseg --i <t1> --o synthseg.nii.gz --vol synthseg_volumes.csv --keepgeom --cpu --threads <threads> [--fast|--robust] through the shared native CLI adapter.

useWhen: Segment a brain MRI of any contrast into the SynthSeg 2.0 FreeSurfer labels on a machine that has FreeSurfer installed.
A next step needs a label map on the input grid, e.g. per-structure volumes with label-volumes and a mask from the same scan.

avoidWhen.when: FreeSurfer is not installed but Neurodesk's synthseg CLI or Webapps suite is.
You only need a brain mask or a skull-stripped image.

preconditions: FreeSurfer 7.4 or a newer dev build (tested with dev 2024-03-27) under /Applications/freesurfer or /usr/local/freesurfer, on PATH, or via FREESURFER_SYNTHSEG.
effects: Writes synthseg.nii.gz (input geometry) and synthseg_volumes.csv to the output directory.
mode robust is slower; mode fast skips some processing.
Runs on the CPU (--cpu); drop --cpu from the neuroflow/cli args on a GPU node.

examples.title: Robust mode for a clinical scan

failures.meaning: No FreeSurfer install with mri_synthseg was found.
failures.remedy: Install FreeSurfer 7.4 or a newer dev build (tested with dev 2024-03-27), or set FREESURFER_SYNTHSEG to its bin/mri_synthseg.

failures.meaning: This mri_synthseg is too old: it lacks --keepgeom or another flag the tool passes.
failures.remedy: Install a FreeSurfer whose mri_synthseg -h lists --keepgeom, or set FREESURFER_SYNTHSEG to one.
Read the step log, and check that t1 is a readable image with neuroflow_inspect.

duration.basis: One gallery run on an Apple-silicon Mac (FreeSurfer dev 2024-03-27, 8 threads, 1 mm T1, running beside SynthStrip): 44 s.
